newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor sees profit doubling by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Accor sees profit doubling by 2000.

text.p: French hotel group Accor aims to double its net profit by the year 2000 to around two billion francs, chairman Jean-Marc Espalioux told the annual shareholders meeting on Wednesday.
"I think that with the Accor 2000 project and the changes in structure that it will bring, we have the means to realise the objective to double net profit by the year 2000," he said.
Its net attributable profit was 1.06 billion in 1996.

Espalioux said he expected gross operating profit to be between 150 and 200 million francs next year, 500 million in 1999 and 750 million in 2000 on a like-for-like basis and barring unexpected economic shifts. For 1997, he said earlier he expected an increase of more than 20 percent in gross operating profit.
